notes.title: Maestro: Duel Of The Fates DLC is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[p][b]What’s New? [/b]ːsteamhappyː[b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Duel of the Fates[/b] DLC now available! 

Feel the power of John Williams’s legendary [i]Star Wars: Episode I[/i] score with your brand new Lightbaton. [/p][p]In addition, every player gets fresh base‑game content: a new décor set, gloves, an orchestra, and a new track: "Battle on the Ice" composed by Sergei Prokofiev.[/p][p]
[b]Maestro: The Complete Edition[/b] 

Conduct with unparalleled precision using Quest hand‑tracking. Master [b]30 musical pieces[/b] across [b]7 breathtaking venues[/b], featuring iconic themes from [i]Harry Potter[/i], [i]Star Wars[/i], [i]Game of Thrones[/i] and [i]Lord of the Rings[/i]. 

Customize your experience with [b]7 complete cosmetic sets[/b], then step onto the podium and embody the music, every gesture resonates. All three DLCs bundled together at a special promo price for a limited time.

[b]Maestro: Version #324 - La Release Note[/b] 📜​[/p][list][*][p]Performance improvements,[/p][/*][*][p]Various UI/UX improvements (main menu, reward objects, subtitles),[/p][/*][*][p]Various localisation fixes,[/p][/*][*][p]New track, costume, venue and hand,[/p][/*][*][p]New DLC - Fates[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Maestro version #301 - La Release Note 📜
notes.notes:
**New:** Left Handed mode is here!
**New:** A DLC stand ('Downloadable Culture') has been added, to browse all the additional culture.

**Improved:** Menus Quality of Life and visual polish
**Fix:** Game audio is no longer mute when game window is not focused (PCVR)
**Fix:** Localisation issues
**Fix:** Items you brought in concert from the menu will now persist if you restart the concert.
**Fix:** Various Crashes
**Fix:** Issues while downloading DLC content
